page_title: HAV 0-1 LIL | Le Havre v Lille 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
90+1' Substitution. Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre) on for Yanis Zouaoui.
90+1' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) receives a yellow card.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' 0 - 1 Goal! Ethan Mbappe feeds Hamza Igamane (Lille), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:1.

86' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
85' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
83' Hamza Igamane (Lille) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
82' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Willy Delajod and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
80' Here comes a substitution. Reda Khadra (Le Havre) is brought on as a substitute for Godson Kyeremeh.
80' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye is replaced by Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre).
77' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) is flagged for offside.
75' Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre) serves up a nice cross, but Berke Ozer punches the ball away.
73' The substitution has been made. Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) has replaced Ngalayel Mukau.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) comes onto the pitch for Osame Sahraoui.
67' The resulting corner from Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) is cleared by the defence.
65' Didier Digard has decided to make a change. Ally Samatta (Le Havre) replaces Simon Ebonog.
65' Substitution. Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Fode Doucoure walks off.
62' The resulting corner from Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

61' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. The referee signals a corner kick to Le Havre.
61' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

60' A pass into the box finds Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Berke Ozer denies him. The referee blows his whistle, Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.
58' The foul by Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre) was seen by Willy Delajod who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
57' Here is a change. Felix Correia is going off and Bruno Genesio gives the last tactical orders to Ethan Mbappe (Lille).
57' Hamza Igamane comes onto the pitch because Olivier Giroud (Lille) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
57' Olivier Giroud (Lille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
54' Olivier Giroud (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
54' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
53' Another situation results in a direct free kick for Le Havre.
51' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
49' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' Olivier Giroud (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Lille will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' Willy Delajod blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Issa Soumare (Le Havre), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
45+3' Thomas Meunier (Lille) receives a yellow card for infringement.
45+1' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the left post.
45+1' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Nathan Ngoy (Lille) for a tough tackle.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
43' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
39' Bruno Genesio is forced to make a change. Aissa Mandi (Lille) is unable to continue due to injury, Chancel Mbemba comes on.
39' The Lille players can’t believe it after referee Willy Delajod signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.

35' Play continues despite the shouts by some Lille players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Willy Delajod interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
35' Surely that's handball by one of the Le Havre players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
34' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) trips an opposition player and Willy Delajod signals a foul.
33' Aissa Mandi (Lille) is able to continue to play.
31' The game is interrupted now, Aissa Mandi (Lille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
28' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
24' The linesman raises his flag. Felix Correia (Lille) is adjudged offside.
22' The free kick from long range, taken by Lille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) commits a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for an infringement.
17' Benjamin Andre (Lille) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
15' The Lille players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
10' Le Havre fail to score from a corner as Berke Ozer (Lille) leaps to collect the ball.

10' That was a nice football moment. Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the left post. Berke Ozer guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! Le Havre force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
9' Willy Delajod couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) and blew his whistle.
7' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
5' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
5' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
5' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Lille will take a corner kick.
3' Felix Correia (Lille) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
2' Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre) commits a rough foul. Willy Delajod stops the game and makes a call.
2' A yellow-coloured card is received by Nathan Ngoy (Lille).
1' The match has just started.
Lille will kick the game off.
Willy Delajod will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
